section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1978
title: PART-I ACCIDENTAL DEATHS IN INDIA ACCIDENTAL DEATHS A total of 118594 accidental deaths were recorded by the Police in India during 1978 compared with the figures of 117338 (+1·I) in 1977 and 111611 (+6·3) in 1976. Volume of Accidental Death per lakh of population: A study of the figures would show that accidental deaths in India recorded an increasing trend from 1971 to 1978 except for 1976 when the total number of accidental deaths came down to 111611 from 113016 in 1975 and again registered an upward trend registering total number of accidental deaths 117338 in 1977 and 118594 in 1978. The volume of accidental deaths per lakh of population has shown a mixed trend during 1971 to 1978 and it ranged between 19·2 for 1971 to 18·2 for 1976 in spite of the fact that the population of India has shown an increasing trend from 1971 to 1978 continuously. The details regarding the number of year-wise accidental deaths and volume of accidental deaths per lakh of population for the period 1971-1978 are set forth in Table-I.
